For investors, the appeal lies in assessing the complete proposition: Dubai Islands as a coastal location, the development's limited scale, the specification of the residences, and the payment terms available at the time of purchase.

description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Mirari Lagoon by Zoya Developments presents a thoughtfully designed collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, bringing together contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, and resort-inspired living. Located in Dubai Industrial City, the development offers fully furnished residences designed to provide comfort, functionality, and modern convenience. With stylish layouts and carefully planned living spaces, each residence creates a welcoming environment for individuals, couples, and families seeking a contemporary home in Dubai. The development offers a range of lifestyle amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and recreation. Residents can enjoy a lagoon-inspired swimming pool, infinity pool, fully equipped fitness centre, jogging track, poolside cabanas, and landscaped outdoor spaces. Dedicated leisure and relaxation areas create opportunities to unwind, enjoy outdoor activities, and experience a resort-style atmosphere within the residential community. Mirari Lagoon combines modern residential comfort with a leisure-focused lifestyle, creating an environment where everyday living is complemented by recreational facilities and thoughtfully designed surroundings. Its fully furnished apartments, contemporary design, and selection of lifestyle amenities make the development an appealing choice for both homeowners and investors looking for a modern residential property in Dubai. With its location in Dubai Industrial City, Mirari Lagoon offers connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai are approximately 10 minutes away, while Palm Jebel Ali is around 20 minutes away. Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai are also accessible by road, offering residents convenient access to shopping, entertainment, business, and leisure destinations. The project features studio apartments starting from approximately AED 565,000, 1-bedroom apartments from AED 899,000, and 2-bedroom apartments from AED 1,127,000. Buyers can benefit from an advertised flexible payment plan of 20% on booking, 28% during construction, 10% on handover, and 42% post-handover over 60 months. With its fully furnished residences, resort-inspired amenities, and flexible payment structure, Mirari Lagoon presents an attractive opportunity for those looking to own a home or explore property investment in Dubai. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Industrial City is an established industrial and commercial destination within the wider Dubai South region, offering connectivity to important transport, logistics, and business hubs. Its strategic position makes it an emerging location for residential developments, particularly for professionals and residents seeking convenient access to employment and infrastructure. The surrounding area benefits from its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, and major road networks connecting different parts of the emirate. These destinations contribute to the area's long-term development potential and accessibility. Residents can also reach shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday facilities across nearby communities. With its growing infrastructure, strategic connectivity, and proximity to major development zones in southern Dubai, Dubai Industrial City offers an interesting residential and investment location. Mirari Lagoon brings together modern furnished apartments, leisure facilities, and convenient access to key destinations, creating a contemporary living option within this developing part of Dubai.

title: DON'T BUY A DREAM BUY AN INCOM -GREEN COMMUNITY
description:
*Imagine You Live Here.*

You wake up at Azizi Raffi. The morning sun pours through your floor-to-ceiling window. Below you, the landscaped gardens of Al Furjan are already alive, kids heading to the playground, joggers on the green path. You are not in the chaos of the city, you are above it.

You make coffee. Your apartment is not just a box, it's thoughtfully planned. Every corner has a purpose. Premium finishes, soft light, space that actually breathes.

You step out. 2 minutes and you are at Al Furjan Metro Station. No car needed. Sheikh Zayed Road is right there, but you don't hear it. You are connected, but still calm.

10 minutes to Ibn Battuta Mall for your morning errands.
15 minutes to Dubai Marina for your evening walk by the water.
20 minutes to Expo City.
25 minutes to Downtown and Burj Khalifa when you want the lights.

You come back home. The temperature-controlled pool is waiting. The gym is fully equipped, empty, quiet. Your car is safe in covered parking. 24/7 security at the gate. This is a *Gated Community. Gardens. Green Community.* Not just words, it's how it feels here.

At night, the whole building glows. AZIZI on the facade, lit up. All windows warm. This is Al Furjan at Twilight, the moment between day and night. And you are in the middle of it.

This is not just an apartment.
This is a ready-to-move-in home.
This is Azizi Raffi. Built by Azizi Developments, for people who want to live, not just invest.

But investors love it too. High rental demand. Long-term appreciation. Because everyone wants what you already have: Location, comfort, and peace of mind.

*Azizi Raffi, Al Furjan. Imagine You Live Here. Now stop imagining.*

description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. From cascading water features to outdoor cinema and relaxation decks, every space is designed to evoke a refined island retreat atmosphere. The residences are delivered fully furnished and fully designed, incorporating a smart home system and refined interior detailing accessorized by Hermès. Layouts are bright and airy, emphasizing natural light and a smooth transition between interior and exterior spaces. Duplex residences feature elevated privacy and, in select units, private pools, enhancing the exclusive waterfront experience. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz represents a harmonious blend of architectural elegance, intelligent living, and curated luxury in a serene island setting. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities. title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Isla Private Residences is a boutique waterfront development on Dubai Islands by Chaimaa Holding, conceived around the philosophy of Dolce Far Niente - the art of refined, intentional living. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building's elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands. The development offers 32 amenities curated across three dedicated lifestyle levels, thoughtfully divided into family, wellness, social, and entertainment experiences. Highlights include a Sanctuary Pool and dedicated children's splash areas, a salt sauna and cold plunge pool for contrast therapy, and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea. Social spaces extend beyond traditional lounges, featuring asunken seating with a fireplace, communal dining terraces, and an outdoor cinema. A rooftop sports lounge and bar, secret garden zones, yoga terraces, and a dedicated entertainment lounge for teens and young adults add a distinctive layer of community-focused living rarely seen in boutique projects on Dubai Islands. Interiors are designed with an emphasis on light, proportion, and refined materiality. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance openness and natural illumination, while contemporary kitchens integrate premium appliances and generous worktops to balance aesthetics with practicality. Bathrooms are conceived as spa-inspired environments, featuring upscale fittings and sophisticated materials that elevate everyday rituals. Each residence includes dedicated utility areas and private balconies, reinforcing seamless indoor-outdoor living and a sense of tranquil coastal retreat. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Creek Haven by Emaar introduces an elevated waterfront lifestyle where contemporary elegance meets the tranquillity of nature. Offering a thoughtfully designed collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, the development combines sophisticated architecture, soothing water views, and abundant natural light to create homes that feel both inviting and refined. Dubai Creek Harbour is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava. The wider destination reflects Dubai's vision for innovative urban development, bringing together contemporary design, sustainability, and a vibrant waterfront setting. With its scenic surroundings, lifestyle attractions, and thoughtfully planned community infrastructure, Dubai Creek Harbour offers an appealing residential destination for homeowners and investors seeking modern waterfront living in Dubai.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Altus by Emaar is a contemporary residential development designed to bring together modern elegance, urban convenience, and sustainable living. Featuring thoughtfully designed residences and a distinctive architectural style, the development offers a refined lifestyle complemented by expansive views and well-planned living spaces. With an emphasis on natural light, functionality, and environmental responsibility, Altus presents a modern approach to comfortable city living. The development offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, catering to individuals, couples, and families. Its combination of modern urban planning, waterfront scenery, and access to key destinations makes it attractive to both homeowners and investors seeking a contemporary address in Dubai. description: Exclusive Fully Furnished Apartments in Business Bay Dubai Business Bay, Dubai's premier business and lifestyle hub, is a vibrant district that seamlessly blends luxury living with a thriving commercial environment. description: Exclusive Sea-front Apartments with Installments on The Palm Jumeirah The Palm Jumeirah, an iconic landmark of Dubai, is a world-renowned man-made island shaped like a palm tree, offering unparalleled luxury and exclusivity. This architectural marvel is home to some of the most sought-after residential properties, five-star hotels, and fine dining destinations. With pristine beaches, panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline, and state-of-the-art amenities, The Palm Jumeirah perfectly combines serene waterfront living with urban convenience. Residents and visitors enjoy a vibrant lifestyle featuring high-end retail outlets, world-class entertainment, and recreational facilities, making it a global symbol of sophistication and modern luxury. Apartments for sale on The Palm Jumeirah, Dubai are located 15 minutes from JBR and Dubai Marina, 17 minutes from international schools and hospitals, 20 minutes from Mall of the Emirates, 25 minutes from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, and 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is a stunning 76-floor architectural masterpiece located in the heart of Palm Jumeirah, designed to resemble organic seashells and ocean waves. This awe-inspiring tower features an exterior with sleek, sinuous curves that reflect the beauty of the sea and the natural environment, making it a standout landmark on Dubai's skyline. The buildings design integrates lush greenery, expansive terraces, and panoramic glass facades, offering breathtaking 180- or 360-degree views of the Arabian Gulf, Dubai skyline, Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, and Ain Dubai. Amenities are thoughtfully curated to cater to a contemporary, ultra-luxurious lifestyle. These include a private sandy beach pool, a rooftop infinity pool on the 71st floor offering unparalleled 360-degree views, and beautifully landscaped recreational areas. Residents enjoy a dedicated 25-meter lap swimming pool, private pools for sky terrace apartments, childrens wet and dry play areas, paddle and squash courts, and a fully equipped gym, spa, and wellness center. Additional highlights are a private caf, lounge, and a business center with meeting rooms. Every residence has a private lift lobby, secure independent storage compartments, and access to concierge services. The project provides separate drivers quarters and generous parking provisions for convenience. The seamless integration of smart home technology and hotel-like services enhances everyday living, while a grand entrance lobby and world-class facilities redefine beachfront luxury. This vertical lake-inspired tower combines tranquility and opulence, offering residents a truly unique coastal living experience. The project offers meticulously designed 3-, 4-, and 5-bedroom residences that embody modern luxury and sophistication. The interiors feature expansive open layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flood the spaces and highlighting the elegant craftsmanship. Each residence is adorned with high-quality finishes, including premium marble flooring, custom cabinetry, and integrated lighting systems that enhance the ambiance. The kitchens are fully fitted with state-of-the-art white goods, sleek countertops, and spacious storage, making them both functional and stylish. Bedrooms come with fitted wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms featuring designer fixtures, double vanities, and rain showers for ultimate comfort. Vast terraces extend from the living spaces, providing seamless indoor-outdoor living and stunning views of lush greenery or private pools. Each home is equipped with smart home technology, private lift lobbies, and secure storage compartments, ensuring privacy and convenience. The interior design emphasizes both elegance and practicality, creating a serene sanctuary tailored for a contemporary, ultra-luxurious lifestyle. DXB-00189

You walk inside... It's fully furnished, premium finishes, everything is done. You walk into the bathroom and you feel like you walked into a spa. Marble, hidden LED glow under the sink, a big mirror, and a calm vibe that makes you forget you're in an apartment.

So whether you live in it and feel that resort life every day... or you rent it out and get a high rental yield because everyone is looking for this area... you win.

This is not an apartment... This is a full resort life, with interest-free installments, pre-launch prices, and limited units.

*Imagine yourself living it... before someone else takes it.*

description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. The design emphasizes luxury and practicality, with concealed cisterns in bathrooms and carefully selected finishes throughout to enhance the overall living experience. UAQ-00004

title: Prescott Legado
description:
Legado by Prescott is a residential tower by Prescott in JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle). It rises 34 storeys, with two basements, a ground floor and five podium levels below 26 residential floors, behind a sleek glass facade. The building holds 343 homes: studios, one-bedroom apartments, two- and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and two- and three-bedroom sky villas. One-bedroom apartments start from 803 sq ft, and two-bedroom apartments range from 1,493 to 1,543 sq ft.

Homes have open-plan layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, smart home technology and fitted kitchens, and the one-bedroom layout includes two bathrooms. The lobby offers a lounge with 24/7 concierge and valet services. Facilities are spread across three floors: a kids' splash park, kids' pool, kids' basketball court and jogging track on the first floor; a clubhouse, library, co-working hub, fitness studio, multilevel cinema and coffee bar on the 14th floor; and a 35-metre infinity pool, sunbathing deck, cabanas, table tennis and meditation decks on the 24th floor. Circle Mall is about 10 minutes away, and Hessa Street, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are all close by.

The project suits buyers looking for a family-oriented tower in JVC with a broad set of shared facilities. Prescott has been active in Dubai since 2006 and has delivered projects such as Prime Residency and Prime Views. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q1 2028.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

This project was designed for those looking to live in the city centre with its pace, conveniences and services without giving up comfort, luxury and privileged views. description:
IT'S 6 PM. YOU'RE FINALLY HOME.

But you didn't just enter an apartment building. You entered a resort.

Your kids run straight to the lagoon pool, laughing. The water is warm, perfect. You wave to your neighbor at the BBQ deck — he's grilling, music low, sunset over the podium gardens.

You skip the traffic to the gym. Why would you go anywhere else? Your gym is downstairs. Fully equipped. Next to it, your wife is in the Aerial Yoga studio, finally getting that hour for herself.

Later, you take your dog to his own park. Yes, he has a park. Then a quick jog on the track surrounded by 500 trees. You breathe. This is Arjan, but it doesn't feel like Dubai. It feels like a private escape.

Upstairs, your laptop is open in the co-working space. You just recorded a podcast in your building's private studio. Your client thinks you rented a studio downtown.

Your friends ask, "Where do you live again?"
You smile. "Arjan. Next to Miracle Garden. 10 minutes from everything, but far from the noise."

They look at your photos. The Family Lagoon. The half-Olympic pool. The co-working lounge. The retail arcade right at your door.

They ask, "How much did this cost?"

You smile again. Because you bought it before everyone else realized — *Arjan is not the future. It's the smart money right now.*

*This isn't a property. It's the moment your life got an upgrade.*

*16 resort amenities. One private address. Limited units left.*

*Welcome to Resort Living in the Heart of Arjan. Welcome Home.*

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. WHEN THE FOREST BECOMES PART OF YOUR EVERYDAY LIFE

Imagine waking up in Dubai...

Contemporary interiors open towards natural light, creating a calm and elegant setting where the outside world feels beautifully close. Whether you choose a one- or two-bedroom residence, the spaces are designed for modern life while keeping a sense of warmth and privacy.

Then, instead of taking the elevator down into another concrete cityscape, you step outside into something different.

Walk beneath the trees.

Take your morning run along the trails.

Cycle through the landscape.

Pause beside the forest pools.

Let the children discover their own world through nature gardens and outdoor spaces, while you find a quiet moment for yourself at the wellness and yoga pavilion.

At Ghaf Woods, nature is not decoration.

It is the lifestyle.

And when you want to reconnect with the energy of Dubai, the city remains within easy reach, with Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road nearby.

Lyra is for those who want a home that feels different the moment they arrive — a place where mornings are calmer, evenings feel lighter and everyday life has room to breathe.

Because sometimes, the greatest luxury in a city like Dubai isn't being closer to everything.

It's having a place where you can finally slow down.

description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Towers A and B are semi-furnished, featuring the same premium built-in wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while enjoying core conveniences. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. description: Luxury Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island is a breathtaking coastal destination in Umm Al Quwain, poised to become one of the UAEs most exclusive lifestyle and investment hubs. Surrounded by pristine beaches and unspoiled natural beauty, the island offers a serene escape while remaining well-connected to the mainland. Planned as a premium residential and leisure community, Siniyah Island will feature luxury beachfront properties, high-end resorts, a championship golf course, world-class amenities, and a marinaall designed to blend modern living with nature. With its strategic location and visionary development, Siniyah Island is set to redefine waterfront living in the Northern Emirates. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project showcases a breathtaking beachfront lifestyle, offering residents an immersive blend of nature, luxury, and recreation. Designed with elegance and coastal harmony in mind, the development features refined architectural elements with towers gracefully oriented toward stunning seascapes. Residents enjoy direct access to both a natural beach and a pristine lagoon, along with world-class amenities including an infinity swimming pool, outdoor cinema, landscaped parks, children's play areas, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. The community is enriched with upscale facilities such as a yacht marina, exclusive golf course, helipad, vibrant retail boulevard, gourmet dining spots, and a community centre. For the adventurous, the island offers thrilling water sports like kite surfing, scuba diving, and paddle boarding, all set against the backdrop of untouched natural beauty and spectacular sunset views. This sanctuary blends tranquil escapes with vibrant activity, creating a unique coastal lifestyle where every detail is tailored for leisure, wellness, and timeless living. The project features elegant interiors crafted for contemporary coastal living, offering spacious 2-bedroom residences with open-plan layouts, expansive balconies, and large windows that frame stunning views of the sea, lagoon, or landscaped parks. Each unit is designed with attention to detail, featuring fully fitted wardrobes and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for everyday convenience. Tower C is delivered fully furnished with modern, stylish interiors for a seamless move-in experience, while Towers A and B are semi-furnished, allowing residents the freedom to personalize their space. The interiors reflect a soft, natural color palette inspired by the islands serene surroundings, blending comfort and sophistication in a setting that feels both luxurious and welcoming. UAQ-00008

title: Lagoon-Facing 1-Bed Apartment at Claydon House
description:
A stunning one-bedroom home with lagoon views to one side and Downtown Dubai on the horizon - this mid-floor apartment at Claydon House offers a serene and compelling proposition. Part of Ellington’s Meydan Horizon community, it features two bathrooms, a smart open-plan layout, and a genuine sense of resort-style living, ideal for anyone looking for space, light, and picturesque views without stepping into a villa-sized budget.

The Tour

The building’s interiors strike an impression from the moment you enter the reception doors. Claydon House has a lobby dressed in warm taupe and grey marble. Sculptural open shelving, soft sofas and marble-topped coffee tables sit to either side, all creating a polished, hotel-like feel before the lift takes you up to the residences.

Inside, the kitchen and living area flow together as one open, light-filled space. Two-tone grey and oak cabinetry surround a marble island with seating and a round dining table sits just beyond, framed by tall windows that draw the daylight straight in. The living area opens directly towards Downtown Dubai, while the relaxing balcony gives glimpses of the evergreen views across Meydan.


The Area

Meydan Horizon sits within the wider Meydan district - a community planned around lush green waterways and a genuine sense of resort living. Crystal lagoons and a waterfront promenade become a part of everyday life, with Downtown Dubai and the wider skyline visible across.

Claydon House provides direct access to the lagoon and offers amenities including an infinity pool, adult lap pool, fitness and yoga facilities, library, cinema, co-working spaces and children’s play areas. Business Bay and DIFC are all within reach.

What We Like

• The lagoon and skyline view

• Resort-style amenities

• Quick access to Downtown Dubai and Business Bay

description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

title: WHERE EUROPEAN ELEGANCE MEETS THE MARINA
raw_area: Le Chateau Pietrus, Dubai Islands, Dubai
description:
Some homes offer an address. Others create a feeling that stays with you.

Le Château Piétrus is designed for the second kind of life.

Set on a first-row marina position at Dubai Islands, beside a landscaped park, it brings together the serenity of waterfront living and the refinement of a private European retreat. Only 86 fully furnished and serviced residences are arranged across seven residential floors, creating an intimate world where privacy, design and hospitality shape everyday life.

From the moment you enter, the experience feels different. Natural travertine, Italian Calacatta marble, curated European interiors and approximately 3.20-metre ceilings create a sense of warmth and space, while panoramic glazing opens the home towards the marina and park. Every residence is delivered turnkey, so you can step directly into a world designed around comfort and elegance.

The real story begins beyond your front door.

Imagine mornings in the Wellness Club, moving between Technogym fitness, Pilates, yoga and meditation before retreating into the hammam or sauna. Later, the pool and landscaped podium become your private escape, with refined cabanas and quiet gardens made for slow afternoons.

As evening arrives, life moves effortlessly towards the French brasserie, residents’ lounge bar or fire lounge. And when the city lights begin to shimmer across the water, residents can reserve the private Riva Dolceriva through the à la carte lifestyle programme with a professional captain, turning an ordinary evening into a sunset journey.

Concierge, valet and 24/7 security complete the experience.

This is more than a waterfront residence. It is a private world where European craftsmanship meets Dubai’s evolving island lifestyle.

Where the marina becomes your view.
Where hospitality becomes part of home.
Where every arrival feels like coming somewhere extraordinary.

Le Château Piétrus — a rare address for those who expect home to feel exceptional.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1353. The development located in Business Bay, Dubai, was conceived as an ultra-luxurious residential tower that asserts itself as one of the tallest and most exclusive housing structures in the world. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields. Student rentals near Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) earn 8-9% gross yields. That's 2-3 points more than most of Dubai's residential market. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. Why DLRC beats Dubai Silicon Oasis 20-30% cheaper to buy, which adds about 1-1.5 points of yield straight away Rents as high or higher (AED 60-65K against 58-62K) Room to grow: DLRC is still an emerging area, so prices have more room to rise than in mature DSO Metro coming: the Academic City station on the Dubai Metro Blue

title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. title: LIVE ABOVE THE ORDINARY, SURROUNDED BY GREEN
raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower A, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Built with smart home automation for lighting and climate control, the residences offer peak modern convenience. Sustainability is prioritized through energy-saving LED fixtures and high-efficiency VRF HVAC technology. Concierge, valet and 24/7 security complete the experience.

This is more than a waterfront residence. It is a private world where European craftsmanship meets Dubai’s evolving island lifestyle.

Where the marina becomes your view.
Where hospitality becomes part of home.
Where every arrival feels like coming somewhere extraordinary.

Le Château Piétrus — a rare address for those who expect home to feel exceptional.

description: Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an "urban lifestyle philosophy" rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Rather than traditional leisure facilities, the project introduces concept-driven spaces such as creative studios, podcast rooms, co-working hubs, wellness zones, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and curated dining experiences. Signature features like the District Table, design labs, and maker spaces create an ecosystem where residents and professionals can connect, create, and evolve - forming a vibrant, ever-changing environment tailored to a new generation of urban living. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

description: Project general facts Interstellar Tower is a visionary addition to the urban skyline, distinguished by its sleek futuristic architecture and bold contemporary design. Located in a prime area, the development embodies innovation and modern elegance, creating a striking architectural landmark. Its thoughtfully designed residences feature spacious layouts, expansive windows, and sophisticated interiors that maximize natural light while delivering a harmonious balance of comfort, style, and functionality. JVT offers a wide array of amenities, catering to both families and individuals. Water features and landscaped gardens add to the charm of this tranquil community, making it an ideal choice for those looking to enjoy modern conveniences in a peaceful, green setting. Whether you're looking for a family-oriented community or a relaxing space to call home, JVT offers the perfect balance of lifestyle and location.

description: One of the Final Opportunities at DG1 Living Positioned on the 13th floor of the striking DG1 Living, this 126 m² corner apartment presents one of the final opportunities to own a two-bedroom residence within one of Business Bay's most recognisable new developments. Designed by internationally acclaimed architectural firm Gensler and developed by DarGlobal, DG1 combines sculptural architecture with a prime waterfront address beside the Dubai Canal, creating a landmark residential tower in the heart of Dubai. Although the tower enjoys a prestigious canal-side location, this particular residence benefits from an open city outlook, offering expansive urban views across Business Bay together with abundant natural light throughout the day. As one of only two remaining two-bedroom apartments currently available within the project, it represents an increasingly rare opportunity for buyers seeking a premium freehold property before completion. The Residence Every element of this apartment has been designed to maximise comfort, light and functionality. The generous 126 m² layout centres around a spacious open-plan living and dining area that connects seamlessly to the private balcony, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor living. Large floor-to-ceiling windows frame the surrounding cityscape while filling the interiors with natural daylight from multiple directions thanks to the apartment's desirable corner position. The contemporary kitchen integrates naturally with the living spaces, allowing the apartment to function equally well as a permanent residence, a second home or an investment property. Both bedrooms provide generous proportions, built-in storage and privacy, while premium materials and refined finishes reinforce the project's luxury positioning. Unlike many developments where every apartment follows an identical template, the corner configuration provides a noticeably brighter environment and a greater feeling of openness throughout the home. Landmark Architecture by Gensler DG1 Living has become one of the most distinctive additions to the Business Bay skyline. Rather than relying on conventional straight-line architecture, the building features flowing terraces and sculpted balconies that create movement throughout the façade. Designed by Gensler, one of the world's leading architectural firms, the tower has been conceived as a contemporary landmark overlooking the Dubai Canal. Its bold architectural identity distinguishes DG1 from many neighbouring residential developments while providing residents with elegant communal areas and thoughtfully planned living spaces. Living in Business Bay Business Bay has evolved into one of Dubai's most desirable mixed-use districts, combining residential, commercial and leisure facilities within a central location. Residents enjoy convenient access to: Dubai Canal Downtown Dubai Burj Khalifa Dubai Mall Dubai Opera DIFC Sheikh Zayed Road Al Khail Road This strategic position makes the apartment equally attractive for professionals working in central Dubai, international buyers seeking a second residence and investors looking for long-term capital appreciation. description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

description: Volta by DAMAC Properties is a premium residential development situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering an exceptional blend of contemporary architecture, urban sophistication, and upscale living. The development features a diverse collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments alongside super-luxury three- and four-bedroom residences, catering to a range of lifestyle preferences. Designed to complement Dubai's dynamic cityscape, the tower combines elegant residential spaces with modern functionality, further enhanced by a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure for added convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully curated lifestyle with dedicated recreational spaces and leisure amenities, including a rooftop amenity area atop the separate podium parking structure. Its prime Downtown Dubai location places residents within easy reach of prestigious shopping destinations, fine dining establishments, entertainment venues, and renowned cultural landmarks. This combination of urban connectivity, premium facilities, and contemporary residential design creates an appealing living environment for those seeking a sophisticated city lifestyle. The interiors are finished with carefully selected materials and contemporary detailing to create a refined and functional living experience. Living and dining areas feature elegant marble flooring, painted walls, and selected accent finishes, while bedrooms incorporate porcelain tile flooring, built-in wardrobes, and thoughtfully designed feature walls in the master bedroom. Bathrooms are appointed with stone countertops, quality sanitary ware, mirrors, shower enclosures, and modern fittings.
