Delivered unfurnished, the residences provide a premium finished foundation that allows homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their individual tastes. Location Description and Benefits Downtown Dubai is one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant destinations, renowned for its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the spectacular Dubai Fountain, the district offers an exceptional combination of luxury shopping, fine dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Its dynamic environment attracts residents and visitors throughout the year, making it one of Dubai's most recognisable lifestyle and residential destinations. The neighbourhood offers a sophisticated urban lifestyle, with an extensive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, stylish cafés, and high-end leisure destinations. Beyond its commercial appeal, Downtown Dubai provides a vibrant residential environment where everyday conveniences and entertainment are seamlessly integrated. From designer boutiques and international restaurants to scenic promenades and lively public spaces, the district caters to those who appreciate a connected and contemporary way of living. Strategically positioned near Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Al Wasl, and Business Bay, Downtown Dubai benefits from excellent connectivity to key commercial districts, residential communities, and major destinations across the city. Its accessible transport links and proximity to essential amenities make it particularly attractive to professionals, frequent travellers, and residents seeking convenient urban living. Combining a prestigious address, landmark surroundings, and a thriving lifestyle scene, Downtown Dubai continues to stand out as one of the city's most desirable destinations for luxury residential living.

title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Bright open spaces, bespoke storage solutions, and refined finishes create a timeless living environment that combines style with practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. description:
This fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment is located on a middle floor of Meera Tower, a landmark 52-storey residential building in Al Habtoor City, directly overlooking the Dubai Water Canal. The apartment enjoys community views with a partial canal outlook, offering a calm yet vibrant urban atmosphere.

The layout is thoughtfully designed, featuring a walk-in closet, a separate laundry room, and well-proportioned living and dining areas. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring in abundant natural light, while the interior finishes combine large-format tiles in the living spaces with warm wood-style flooring in the bedrooms. Neutral beige and white tones create a bright, timeless interior suitable for comfortable long-term living.

Meera Tower is part of a prestigious waterfront development, where residents benefit from access to Dubai’s largest leisure deck. The podium level features infinity and social pools, landscaped gardens, picnic and barbecue areas, a café, and an open-air amphitheatre. The marina promenade along the canal is lined with elegant boutiques and retail outlets, creating a resort-style lifestyle in the heart of the city.

Residents also enjoy access to five-star hotel facilities within Al Habtoor City, as well as on-site amenities including a tennis academy, helipad, clinic, supermarket, and retail spaces. The building’s spacious lobby is finished with panoramic windows, a welcoming reception desk, and comfortable waiting areas.

Strategically located, Meera Tower offers excellent connectivity. Business Bay Metro Station is within a 5-minute drive, Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall are reachable in under 10 minutes, Dubai Marina in 16 minutes, Palm Jumeirah in 18 minutes, and Dubai International Airport in approximately 13 minutes.

description: Luxurious Sea-View Flats with Private Beach Access on Dubai Islands The development is located within Dubai Islands, a premium waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, designed to offer beachside living with convenient access to the mainland. Dubai Islands combines the heritage charm of old Dubai with a modern coastal lifestyle, creating a unique environment where residents can enjoy sea views, sandy beaches, and a growing hospitality-driven master community. Its island setting provides a resort atmosphere while remaining well-connected to the city. In terms of connectivity, flats for sale in Dubai Islands are approximately 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport (DXB) and around 2425 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall, depending on traffic. Palm Jumeirah can typically be reached in about 3540 minutes, while JBR and Dubai Marina are roughly 40 minutes away. This balance between island privacy and city accessibility enhances both lifestyle comfort and rental appeal. The project follows a low-rise boutique concept (generally structured as G+2P+8) with a limited number of flats, emphasizing privacy and exclusivity. A defining feature is its climate-controlled sunken balconies and winter garden concept, designed to allow year-round use of outdoor spaces. Social amenities include an infinity swimming pool with a leisure deck, a jacuzzi, a childrens pool and play areas, a fully equipped gym, yoga space, outdoor cinema, BBQ areas, landscaped relaxation zones, hammock garden, and a community garden. Buyers are drawn to the Dubai Islands because it offers a rare combination of beachfront living, limited supply, and strong future growth potential within a master-planned island destination. From an investment and lifestyle perspective, purchasing property in Dubai offers access to a globally recognized real estate market that combines modern infrastructure, safety, and high living standards. The city supports foreign ownership in designated areas and regulates off-plan developments through escrow systems designed to protect buyers. A waterfront residence in an emerging island community, therefore, presents both a luxury living experience and long-term investment potential in one of the worlds most dynamic property markets. title: Dubai Maritime City, Dubai
description: Portside Square is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture takes inspiration from the movement and rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers - Portside Residences I, II, and III - the development is characterised by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that interact beautifully with natural light. Its architectural design creates a harmonious relationship between sea, sky, and structure, offering a refined residential environment with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views. The development presents a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents can enjoy leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a dedicated fitness pavilion, and spa and sauna facilities. Additional amenities include yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a dedicated children's club, creating an environment that caters to different lifestyles and age groups. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the community, with jogging paths, landscaped garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges offering inviting places to relax, exercise, and connect. The combination of wellness facilities, recreational spaces, and social areas creates a balanced lifestyle with a distinct waterfront character. The residences feature contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials, natural textures, and refined detailing. Equipped kitchens incorporate premium appliances, combining modern functionality with elegant design. Delivered unfurnished, the homes offer residents the flexibility to personalise their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully selected finishes. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

description: Etherea is a contemporary residential development designed around the principles of balance, privacy, and understated elegance. Defined by clean lines, natural textures, and a considered approach to modern design, Etherea creates an atmosphere where light, space, and materials work together seamlessly. Its architectural character reflects a philosophy of quiet sophistication, offering residents a peaceful environment within Dubai's evolving urban landscape. Lifestyle Amenities & Wellness Etherea features a thoughtfully curated collection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote relaxation, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. Key amenities include: Adult and children's swimming pools Jacuzzi and outdoor shower facilities Sun lounging areas Landscaped walking and cycling paths Dedicated yoga and aerobics platform Shaded seating and relaxation areas Children's play areas With its landscaped surroundings, greenery, and carefully arranged outdoor spaces, the development encourages a balanced lifestyle centred on comfort, wellness, and community living. Premium Interiors & Timeless Finishes The residences at Etherea showcase a sophisticated palette of natural materials and carefully selected finishes, creating interiors that feel warm, elegant, and contemporary. The neighbourhood's green spaces and family-friendly environment make it appealing to families, professionals, and individuals seeking a comfortable home away from the intensity of Dubai's busiest districts, while remaining connected to the city's major destinations. A New Perspective on Contemporary Living Etherea brings together refined architecture, premium natural finishes, wellness-focused amenities, and the established residential appeal of Jumeirah Village Circle. Designed for those who value privacy, tranquillity, and thoughtful contemporary design, the development offers a distinctive approach to modern living in Dubai. description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields. Student rentals near Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) earn 8-9% gross yields. That's 2-3 points more than most of Dubai's residential market. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. Why DLRC beats Dubai Silicon Oasis 20-30% cheaper to buy, which adds about 1-1.5 points of yield straight away Rents as high or higher (AED 60-65K against 58-62K) Room to grow: DLRC is still an emerging area, so prices have more room to rise than in mature DSO Metro coming: the Academic City station on the Dubai Metro Blue

With its combination of coastal surroundings, leisure opportunities, and growing residential infrastructure, Dubai Islands presents an attractive setting for those seeking a contemporary waterfront lifestyle in Dubai.

Location Description and Benefits Jebel Ali is a strategically positioned district in Dubai, combining a strong commercial presence with residential communities and convenient urban connectivity. Situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline, the area is internationally recognised for Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's major container ports, playing a significant role in global trade and maritime commerce. The district's economic importance is further strengthened by Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a prominent business and industrial hub that hosts multinational companies across a wide range of sectors. This thriving commercial environment contributes to employment opportunities and supports the area's continued development. Alongside its business infrastructure, Jebel Ali offers residential neighbourhoods, essential services, educational facilities, and leisure options that contribute to a well-rounded lifestyle. Connectivity is another key advantage, with Sheikh Zayed Road providing convenient road access to major destinations across Dubai, while the Dubai Metro serves selected areas of the district. With its emphasis on quality placemaking, integrated amenities, and long-term urban value, DIFC Zabeel District is positioned as one of Dubai's most forward-looking and desirable central neighborhoods.

title: Ras Al Khor, Dubai
description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

description: Elegant Flats with Resort-Style Amenities in Ras Al Khaimah Downtown Mina in Ras Al Khaimah represents a beautiful fusion of vibrant urban activity and serene coastal tranquility. Once defined by 18 kilometers of pristine shoreline, this premium island has evolved into a highly desirable residential destination shaped by connections, design, and light. Seamlessly linking a vibrant pedestrian boulevard, lush landscaped parks, and a world-class marina, it offers an exclusive lifestyle where city pace meets island calm. Residents are surrounded by beautiful natural mangroves filled with native wildlife, with the steady backdrop of the Hajar Mountains. The are situated just a 10-minute drive away from the highly anticipated Wynn Casino and only 15 minutes from the iconic Al Marjan Island. Travel is effortless with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport reachable within 15 to 20 minutes. Furthermore, Dubai International Airport (DXB) is a smooth 45 to 60-minute drive, and Zayed International Airport in Abu Dhabi is accessible in 125 minutes. The residential complex features an outstanding collection of outdoor and indoor amenities designed for health, recreation, and social connection. Outdoors, residents can enjoy a 25-meter main lap pool, a kid's splash area, a jogging track, and an outdoor fitness gym. The beautifully landscaped gardens also include a padel court, a mini-golf course, a skate park, and a dedicated pet park. Indoors, the double-height grand lobby welcomes you to a multipurpose clubhouse, co-working spaces, a premium yoga studio, and a curated art gallery. Every flat is beautifully designed, starting from compact studios up to spectacular four-bedroom penthouses, offering breathtaking views. Built with smart home automation for lighting and climate control, the residences offer peak modern convenience. Sustainability is prioritized through energy-saving LED fixtures and high-efficiency VRF HVAC technology. The interiors showcase premium craftsmanship, high-quality finishes, and expansive double-glazed thermal windows that frame the sea, park, or marina, providing an abundance of natural light. title: Ellington Portside Square
description:
Portside Square is developed by Ellington in Mina Rashid, a historic port district that opened in 1972 and now includes a marina and cruise terminal. The scheme has three residential towers, named Portside Residences I, II and III, each with a ground floor, a podium, 16 residential floors and a roof level, and curved faÃ§ades drawn from the movement of wind and water. Its 408 homes range from studios of 396 sq ft to four-bedroom penthouses of 3,441 sq ft, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom units with a study in between.

Apartments are delivered with equipped kitchens and are otherwise unfurnished. Studios and one- and two-bedroom homes come with one parking space, and three- and four-bedroom homes with two. A first-floor amenity deck has a leisure pool, a kids' pool, cabanas, a running track, an outdoor fitness area and gardens. The pavilion adds a cinema and games lounge, an arcade, co-working pods, a spa with saunas and hot and cold plunge pools, yoga and Pilates areas, a fitness studio with a juice bar and a clubhouse. The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.

The location links Mina Rashid's maritime heritage with short drives to the city's business districts, including DIFC at about 14 minutes. Homes are offered on a freehold basis, and the project is registered with the Dubai Land Department. The payment plan asks for 20% on booking, 50% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

description: Bay Grove Residences Phase 4 by Nakheel marks the final release of an exclusive waterfront community, offering an elevated coastal lifestyle within a beautifully planned island setting. Located in the Marina District on Island B, the development brings together contemporary architecture, landscaped surroundings, and direct access to Crystal Beach. Panoramic waterfront views, spacious terraces, and floor-to-ceiling windows create a seamless connection between the residences and their natural surroundings. The development offers a diverse selection of homes, including 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, alongside an exclusive penthouse. Each residence is thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, generous natural light, and expansive outdoor spaces that enhance the experience of modern waterfront living. Residents can enjoy an extensive collection of resort-inspired amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and family experiences. Facilities include infinity and family swimming pools, a clubhouse with a cinema and games room, fitness and yoga studios, outdoor gyms, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. A landscaped podium garden with shaded seating, a half basketball court, BBQ areas, and pet wash stations further enriches the community experience. The development also offers direct access to jogging and cycling paths, along with a swimmable beach that creates an inviting setting for outdoor recreation and relaxation. The combination of leisure, fitness, and social spaces encourages a balanced lifestyle for residents of all ages. The interiors reflect the calm and understated elegance of coastal living, featuring warm wood textures, light stone finishes, and a soft contemporary colour palette. High-quality specifications include stone countertops and backsplashes, refined bathroom vanities, accent tiles, metal detailing, and premium flooring and wall finishes. Kitchens are fitted with quality cabinetry and built-in appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their spaces. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Islands is an ambitious waterfront destination comprising five interconnected islands, designed to bring together residential communities, hospitality, retail, and leisure experiences. Surrounded by beaches, landscaped areas, and expansive coastal views, the destination offers a distinctive island lifestyle with a strong connection to nature and the sea. The islands are connected to mainland Dubai through established road infrastructure, providing residents with convenient access to the city's key destinations. Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah are among the major lifestyle and entertainment hubs accessible by road, allowing residents to enjoy a quieter coastal environment while remaining connected to the wider city. The master development is planned to feature an extensive range of lifestyle attractions, including luxury hotels, waterfront restaurants, premium retail destinations, and recreational facilities. Its combination of beachfront surroundings and leisure infrastructure is designed to create a vibrant destination for residents and visitors alike. With its coastal setting, evolving infrastructure, and vision for an integrated island community, Dubai Islands presents an appealing proposition for homeowners seeking a relaxed waterfront lifestyle and investors looking towards the growth of an emerging destination. The blend of natural beauty, modern amenities, and city connectivity makes it a distinctive addition to Dubai's residential landscape.
